full_judgment: 11. The other point that must be disposed of is, that Mr. Nuzrul Islam Chowdhury, the learned Advocate for the petitioners, has taken a ground that the investigation for the second charge sheet was held without extension of time from the Sessions Judge for submission of the same But Mr. AKM Faiz, the learned Advocate for the opposite parties, has submitted and also cited a decision in support of his submission with cogent reason that the further investigation is held in accordance with section 173 (3B) of the Crpc and for that further investigation there is no specific time of limitation. It appears that the second charge sheet which is impugned was filed not under section 165 of the CrPC but under section 173 (3B) of the CrPC, unlike in investigation under section 165, no extension of time by the Magistrate or the Sessions Judge is, necessary in respect of further investigation. Therefore this ground urged by Mr. Nazrul Islam Chowdhury does not stand.
